title: pro integral residue derived unit
statement: For a closed immersion i:D→Z and n>0, the normalized supported integral generator i_*Z_D→forget(i_*(ULift(Z/n))_D) on the pro-etale site has the unbounded DerivedUnit property [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data, def-sp-exact-functor-derived-unit].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Pull the supported etale integer/residue short exact sequence back by exact comparison. Transport its two integral terms by the canonical supported integral comparison and its residue term by the coefficient-forgetting comparison followed by the supported residue comparison. All are isomorphisms. The defining formula for the pro integral generator identifies the transported quotient map. Thus the sequence nF→F→forget(i_*R_D) is short exact. Apply the site-general quotient-derived-unit theorem directly on the pro-etale site.

lean.statement:
theorem pro_integral_residue_derived_unit (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    {D Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    (cartierForget (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)) Z).DerivedUnit
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology D) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))))
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))) i).obj
        (geoCartierConstant (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)) D))
      (cartierProIntegralGenerator (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)) i)
